data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $215,601,000 (2017: $225,755,000) is a deterioration of $48,466,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2017: deterioration $5,582,000). data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year) was $377.328m. Analysis of development shows a small gross release (~$1.1m) on underwriting years prior to 2017 based on the gross claims development table, however narrative and reserve notes report a $48.5m deterioration in claims reserves on prior accident years (reported on a net basis), primarily driven by adverse development in Non-Marine Liability, Property Direct & Facultative and Specie & Cargo together with strengthened IBNR. The calendar year was also affected by multiple 2018 natural catastrophe events (Florence, Michael, Jebi, Trami and California wildfires) which produced a combined net cost of $21.7m. Overall the syndicate reports mixed reserve dynamics: gross triangle indicates a small release on older years but the syndicate strengthened net reserves materially due to claim notifications and IBNR recalibration, particularly in Liability and Property-related accounts.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (sum of diagonal movements for UW years <=2016) and indicates a small release (~$1.1m). The report's narrative and Note 6 explicitly state a $48.466m deterioration in prior year claims reserves, but that figure is presented in the context of net calendar year claims incurred (net of reinsurance). Where the report gives class-level prior year movement figures ($26.6m, $13.2m, $4.9m) these appear to be net amounts; gross movements by class are not provided. RITC and reinsurance recoveries are present in the accounts and can distort simple comparisons; users should note the gross/net distinction and differing sources.
